Joao de Loureiro, Flora Cochinchinensis, Lisbon 1790.
Internet Archive: floracochinchine01lour (vol.1), floracochinchine02lour (vol.2)
https://archive.org/details/floracochinchine01lour
https://archive.org/details/floracochinchine02lour
Retrieved 2026-08-30. Public domain (published 1790).

Loureiro was a Portuguese Jesuit who spent some thirty-five years in Cochinchina
(Vietnam). This is the first systematic flora of the region.

TOMATO CONTENT, vol.1, Pentandria Monogynia, printed pp.130-131:
Sp. 8 SOLANUM LYCOPERSICUM -- Vietnamese name given as "Ca tiu tlang"
Sp. 9 SOLANUM PERUVIANUM -- Vietnamese name given as "Ca tau ving"
Both cross-referenced to Rumphius, Herb. Amb. lib.9 cap.49 tab.154 f.1, and to
Bauhin's "Solanum pomiferum, fructu rotundo, striato, molli", Pinax p.167.
